decisions.why: All examples (Brady M210, BMP71 printer kits) are label printers, which digital:hw explicitly names as clinical IT hardware.
Two of three examples are explicit lab inoculation needles (TSC, VIOLET) for microbiology work, not clinical vascular access.
Cole Parmer CC-200 colony counter is standard microbiology-lab analytical equipment for counting bacterial colonies.
Fetal Bovine Serum and NCS21 Supplement are lab reagents used in cell culture, matching laboratory consumables.
Liebherr and Haier biomedical freezers with drawers are medical-grade cold storage devices for lab and clinical samples.
appCertiFi Mixes and dNTP Mix are molecular biology PCR reagents, a standard laboratory consumable.
appMARKER protein ladders are molecular biology assay consumables used in electrophoresis workflows.
Hettich swing-out rotor centrifuges are standard laboratory sample-preparation equipment.
Molecular Biology Grade Agarose and appGLOW Safe Stain are gel electrophoresis lab consumables.
HBSS/FBS/antibiotic transport medium mixes are cell and specimen transport reagents, a lab consumable.
Corning Collagen I and Poly-D-Lysine are cell culture coating reagents, standard lab consumables.
The qPCR 96-well plate example is a molecular diagnostics labware consumable.
Corning Matrigel is a cell culture extracellular matrix reagent, a laboratory consumable.
Haier -60C biomedical chest freezer is medical-grade cold-chain storage equipment.
Sterilin plain swab is a basic microbiology specimen-collection consumable, matching laboratory consumables.
Zeiss immersion oil is a microscopy consumable used with oil-immersion lab objectives.
Haier -40C biomedical freezers with rapid cooling are medical-grade cold-chain storage equipment.
3D Cell Culture Scaffolds are consumable cell culture matrices used in laboratory work.
Nylon blotting membrane rolls are molecular biology Western blot laboratory consumables.
Example is a Hawksley haemocytometer, a standard laboratory cell-counting consumable.
Example is a self-adhesive screw-cap identification label for lab bottles (Duran), a laboratory consumable.
Example is a complete mini vertical electrophoresis system, laboratory analytical equipment used for protein/gel electrophoresis.
Example is a Whatman PTFE syringeless filter, a standard laboratory filtration consumable.
Example is a CN microfunnel for laboratory filtration, a laboratory consumable.
